command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service || true; systemctl --user is-enabled frankenstein-local-bridge.service || true; systemctl --user status frankenstein-local-bridge.service --no-pager -l | tail -n 60 || true; echo '===PROCESS==='; pgrep -af 'local_bridge_daemon.py' || true; echo '===JOURNAL==='; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-local-bridge.service -n 120 --no-pager || true; echo '===STATE REPO==='; cd "$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo" 2>/dev/null && git status --short --branch && git remote -v && git log -1 --oneline || true; echo '===DISK MEM==='; df -h "$HOME" | tail -n 1; free -h | sed -n '1,3p'
